title: Theater Location
description: A location marker placed on an operational theater

galacticPos.description: Optional galactic position displayed beneath the location name

icon.description: SVG filename from logo_art directory used as the marker icon

iconColor.description: CSS color used as the fill (body) of the marker icon

iconEdgeColor.description: CSS color reserved for the marker icon edge/outline (no UI control yet; kept for a future iteration)

iconScale.description: Scale multiplier for the marker icon

visibleToPlayers.description: Whether this location marker is visible to players

x.description: Normalized horizontal position (0..1) for flat theaters

y.description: Normalized vertical position (0..1) for flat theaters

assignedJobIds.description: Job IDs assigned to this location (references into jobs.json)

childTheaterId.description: Optional theater ID to drill into from this location (sublocations)
